CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_user_partner_id()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT CASE
           WHEN count(*) FILTER (WHERE pu.revoked_at IS NULL) <> 1 THEN NULL
           WHEN bool_or(pa.ativo IS TRUE AND pa.deleted_at IS NULL
                        AND pa.commercial_owner_organization_id IS NOT NULL
                        AND pu.tenant_id IS NOT NULL
                        AND pu.tenant_id = pa.commercial_owner_organization_id)
                FILTER (WHERE pu.revoked_at IS NULL)
           THEN (array_agg(pu.partner_id) FILTER (WHERE pu.revoked_at IS NULL))[1]
         END
  FROM public.partner_users pu
  LEFT JOIN public.partner_accounts pa ON pa.id = pu.partner_id
  WHERE pu.user_id = auth.uid();
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.b2b_phase1_order_visible(p_order uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.partner_orders o WHERE o.id=p_order AND public.b2b_phase1_partner_visible(o.partner_id,false));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.b2b_phase1_partner_visible(p_partner uuid, p_technical boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$ SELECT platform_private.b2b_phase1_partner_visible(p_partner,p_technical); $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_valid_b2b_partner_user(p_user_id uuid, p_partner_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT platform_private.platform_actor_access_ready(p_user_id)
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles p JOIN public.organizations o ON o.id=p.organization_id
 JOIN public.partner_users pu ON pu.user_id=p.user_id
 JOIN public.partner_accounts pa ON pa.id=pu.partner_id
 JOIN public.organizations owner ON owner.id=pa.commercial_owner_organization_id
 WHERE p.user_id=p_user_id AND pa.id=p_partner_id AND p.ativo AND o.ativo AND o.status='ativa'
 AND owner.ativo AND owner.status='ativa' AND pa.ativo AND pa.deleted_at IS NULL
 AND p.organization_id=pu.tenant_id AND pu.tenant_id=owner.id
 AND (o.partner_account_id IS NULL OR o.partner_account_id=pa.id)
 AND pu.revoked_at IS NULL AND pu.valid_from<=now())
 AND (SELECT count(*) FROM public.partner_users WHERE user_id=p_user_id)=1
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles WHERE user_id=p_user_id AND role IN ('parceiro_b2b','parceiro_b2b_tecnico'))
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles WHERE user_id=p_user_id AND role NOT IN ('parceiro_b2b','parceiro_b2b_tecnico','cliente_produtor'));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.b2b_owner_internal_partner_readable(p_partner uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  -- Read-only predicate. Internal staff (administrador/gestor_comercial/financeiro) of the active organization that
  -- commercially owns an active partner. External roles or active partner links deny. Reads no partner_orders (no recursion).
  SELECT auth.uid() IS NOT NULL AND p_partner IS NOT NULL
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles r WHERE r.user_id = auth.uid()
                    AND r.role::text IN ('parceiro_b2b','parceiro_b2b_tecnico','cliente_produtor'))
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.partner_users pu WHERE pu.user_id = auth.uid() AND pu.revoked_at IS NULL)
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles r WHERE r.user_id = auth.uid()
                AND r.role::text IN ('administrador','gestor_comercial','financeiro'))
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.partner_accounts pa
                JOIN public.organizations owner ON owner.id = pa.commercial_owner_organization_id
                     AND owner.ativo IS TRUE AND owner.status = 'ativa'
                WHERE pa.id = p_partner AND pa.ativo IS TRUE AND pa.deleted_at IS NULL
                  AND pa.commercial_owner_organization_id = platform_private.h15_actor_organization())
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.b2b_resale_delivery_status_transition_valid_v1(o partner_orders, n partner_orders)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
 RETURN (
  EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM platform_private.b2b_resale_logistics_gate_v1 WHERE singleton AND enabled IS TRUE)
  AND platform_private.b2b_internal_commercial_actor() IS TRUE
  AND o.id=n.id AND o.status::text='aprovado' AND n.status::text='entregue'
  AND o.ready_for_production IS FALSE AND n.ready_for_production IS FALSE
  AND n.receivable_generated IS FALSE
  AND (to_jsonb(n)-ARRAY['status','updated_at']) IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (to_jsonb(o)-ARRAY['status','updated_at'])
  AND EXISTS(
   SELECT 1 FROM platform_private.delivery_context_20261030 dc
   JOIN public.entregas e ON e.id=dc.target AND e.partner_order_id=n.id
   JOIN public.ordens_servico os ON os.id=e.ordem_servico_id AND os.partner_order_id=n.id
   JOIN public.partner_accounts pa ON pa.id=n.partner_id
    AND pa.commercial_owner_organization_id=dc.organization_id AND pa.commercial_owner_organization_id=os.organization_id
   WHERE dc.txid=txid_current() AND dc.actor=auth.uid() AND dc.action='confirm' AND dc.mutation='done'
    AND e.organization_id=dc.organization_id AND e.status::text='entregue' AND e.receivable_id IS NULL
    AND platform_private.b2b_resale_delivery_order_valid_v1(e) IS TRUE
  )
  AND NOT EXISTS(
   SELECT 1 FROM public.entregas e JOIN public.ordens_servico os ON os.id=e.ordem_servico_id
   WHERE os.partner_order_id=n.id AND e.status::text NOT IN ('entregue','cancelada')
  )
  -- TODOS os itens precisam ter exatamente sua quantidade confirmada. Uma OS ou
  -- entrega de outro item nunca completa este item; canceladas não somam, e
  -- excesso também impede a transição. O snapshot econômico permanece o mesmo.
  AND NOT EXISTS(
   SELECT 1 FROM public.partner_order_items i
   LEFT JOIN public.ordens_servico os ON os.partner_order_item_id=i.id
    AND os.partner_order_id=n.id AND os.origem='b2b'
   LEFT JOIN public.entregas e ON e.ordem_servico_id=os.id AND e.partner_order_id=n.id
    AND e.status::text='entregue' AND e.receivable_id IS NULL
   WHERE i.order_id=n.id
   GROUP BY i.id,i.quantidade
   HAVING coalesce(sum(e.quantidade_entregue),0) IS DISTINCT FROM i.quantidade
  )
  -- Nenhuma entrega confirmada pode ficar fora dos itens imutáveis do pedido.
  AND NOT EXISTS(
   SELECT 1 FROM public.entregas e
   JOIN public.ordens_servico os ON os.id=e.ordem_servico_id AND os.partner_order_id=n.id
   LEFT JOIN public.partner_order_items i ON i.id=os.partner_order_item_id AND i.order_id=n.id
   WHERE e.partner_order_id=n.id AND e.status::text='entregue' AND i.id IS NULL
  )
  ) IS TRUE;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.b2b_resale_delivery_order_valid_v1(e entregas)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM platform_private.b2b_resale_logistics_gate_v1 WHERE singleton AND enabled IS TRUE)
  AND (e.status::text='separado' OR platform_private.resale_pilot_delivery_scope_v1('b2b_resale',NULL,auth.uid(),e.organization_id,e.id) IS TRUE)
  AND e.id IS NOT NULL AND e.organization_id IS NOT NULL AND e.partner_order_id IS NOT NULL
  AND e.receivable_id IS NULL AND e.ordem_servico_id IS NOT NULL AND e.ordem_servico_onfarm_id IS NULL
  AND e.cliente_id IS NULL AND EXISTS(
   SELECT 1 FROM public.ordens_servico os
   JOIN public.partner_orders po ON po.id=os.partner_order_id AND po.id=e.partner_order_id
   JOIN public.partner_accounts pa ON pa.id=po.partner_id AND pa.commercial_owner_organization_id=os.organization_id
    AND pa.ativo IS TRUE AND pa.deleted_at IS NULL
   WHERE os.id=e.ordem_servico_id AND os.organization_id=e.organization_id AND os.origem='b2b'
    AND os.partner_order_item_id IS NOT NULL AND os.produto_id=e.produto_id AND os.microrganismo_id IS NULL
    AND po.status::text IN ('aprovado','aguardando_entrega','em_separacao','enviado','entregue','faturado')
    AND po.ready_for_production IS FALSE AND po.receivable_generated IS FALSE
    AND po.payment_condition_status='defined' AND po.financial_approval_status NOT IN ('pending','rejected')
    AND platform_private.c2_external_origin_contract_valid(po.c2_external_origin_snapshot) IS TRUE
    AND po.internal_economic_snapshot IS NOT NULL AND po.internal_origin_snapshot IS NULL
  )) IS TRUE;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.c2_accounting_promotion_ok(o jsonb, n jsonb, order_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT coalesce(o->>'contract'='C2_EXTERNAL_ORDER_REQUEST_PENDING_ACCOUNTING_V1'
  AND n->>'contract'='C2_EXTERNAL_ORDER_ORIGIN_V1' AND platform_private.b2b_internal_origin_valid(n)
  AND n->>'organization_id'=o->>'organization_id' AND n->>'partner_id'=o->>'partner_id' AND n->>'actor_user_id'=o->>'actor_user_id'
  AND n->>'promoted_from_contract'='C2_EXTERNAL_ORDER_REQUEST_PENDING_ACCOUNTING_V1'
  AND platform_private.has_ticket('c2_accounting_promote',order_id),false)
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.has_ticket(_scope text, _target uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM platform_private.authz_tickets
                 WHERE txid = txid_current() AND scope = _scope AND target = _target);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.platform_actor_access_ready(p_user uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles p WHERE p.user_id=p_user AND p.ativo IS TRUE AND p.senha_provisoria IS FALSE)
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.platform_org_admin_invites i WHERE i.user_id=p_user AND (i.access_operation_status='processing' OR (i.access_valid_after IS NOT NULL AND auth.uid()=p_user AND to_timestamp(COALESCE((auth.jwt()->>'iat')::bigint,0))<=i.access_valid_after)));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.entitlements_for_user(_uid uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(module_key text, feature_key text, limit_value numeric, config jsonb)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  WITH actor AS (
    SELECT p.organization_id
    FROM public.profiles p
    JOIN public.organizations org
      ON org.id = p.organization_id
     AND org.ativo IS TRUE
    WHERE p.user_id = _uid
      AND p.ativo IS TRUE
      AND p.organization_id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY p.created_at, p.organization_id
    LIMIT 1
  ), current_subscription AS (
    SELECT s.organization_id, s.plan_version_id
    FROM public.organization_subscriptions s
    JOIN actor a ON a.organization_id = s.organization_id
    JOIN public.saas_plan_versions v
      ON v.id = s.plan_version_id
     AND v.status = 'PUBLISHED'
     AND v.effective_from <= now()
     AND (v.effective_to IS NULL OR v.effective_to > now())
    WHERE s.plan_version_id IS NOT NULL
      AND (
        s.status = 'ACTIVE'
        OR (s.status = 'TRIAL' AND s.trial_ends_at IS NOT NULL AND s.trial_ends_at > now())
      )
      AND (s.cancel_at IS NULL OR s.cancel_at > now())
    ORDER BY s.started_at DESC, s.id DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ), candidates AS (
    SELECT f.id AS feature_id, f.module_id, f.key AS feature_key,
           vf.enabled AS base_enabled, vf.limit_value AS base_limit, vf.config AS base_config
    FROM current_subscription s
    JOIN public.saas_plan_version_features vf ON vf.plan_version_id = s.plan_version_id
    JOIN public.saas_features f ON f.id = vf.feature_id AND f.active IS TRUE
    UNION
    SELECT f.id, f.module_id, f.key, false, NULL::numeric, NULL::jsonb
    FROM current_subscription s
    JOIN public.organization_feature_overrides o ON o.organization_id = s.organization_id
    JOIN public.saas_features f ON f.id = o.feature_id AND f.active IS TRUE
    WHERE o.ended_at IS NULL
      AND o.starts_at <= now()
      AND (o.ends_at IS NULL OR o.ends_at > now())
  ), effective AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (c.feature_id)
      c.feature_id, c.module_id, c.feature_key,
      CASE
        WHEN o.mode = 'REVOKE' THEN false
        WHEN o.mode = 'GRANT' THEN true
        ELSE c.base_enabled
      END AS enabled,
      CASE
        WHEN o.mode = 'GRANT' THEN o.limit_value
        WHEN o.mode = 'REVOKE' THEN NULL::numeric
        ELSE c.base_limit
      END AS effective_limit,
      c.base_config AS effective_config
    FROM candidates c
    CROSS JOIN current_subscription s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT x.mode, x.limit_value
      FROM public.organization_feature_overrides x
      WHERE x.organization_id = s.organization_id
        AND x.feature_id = c.feature_id
        AND x.ended_at IS NULL
        AND x.starts_at <= now()
        AND (x.ends_at IS NULL OR x.ends_at > now())
      ORDER BY x.created_at DESC, x.id DESC
      LIMIT 1
    ) o ON true
    ORDER BY c.feature_id
  )
  SELECT m.key::text, e.feature_key::text, e.effective_limit::numeric, e.effective_config
  FROM effective e
  JOIN public.saas_modules m ON m.id = e.module_id AND m.active IS TRUE
  WHERE e.enabled IS TRUE
  ORDER BY m.key, e.feature_key
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.has_role(_user_id uuid, _role app_role)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles r JOIN public.profiles p ON p.user_id=r.user_id WHERE r.user_id=_user_id AND r.role=_role AND p.ativo IS TRUE AND platform_private.platform_actor_access_ready(p.user_id));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.has_role(_user_id uuid, _role app_role)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$ SELECT platform_private.has_role(_user_id,_role); $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.h15_actor_organization()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$ SELECT platform_private.h15_actor_organization(); $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_cc_can_prepare(p_uid uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT p_uid IS NOT NULL AND (
    public.has_role(p_uid,'administrador'::app_role) OR
    public.has_role(p_uid,'financeiro'::app_role) OR
    public.has_role(p_uid,'gestor_comercial'::app_role));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public._saas_user_has_feature(_uid uuid, _feature_key text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM platform_private.entitlements_for_user(_uid) e
    WHERE e.feature_key = _feature_key
  )
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_b2b_status_is_operational(p_status partner_order_status)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT p_status IN (
    'em_producao','produzido','aguardando_entrega','confirmado',
    'em_separacao','enviado','entregue','faturado'
  )::boolean
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_platform_superadmin(_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles r
    WHERE r.user_id = _user_id AND r.role = 'superadmin'::public.app_role
  )
$function$
